answer: Bind each identity to a slowly accruing trust score earned only through independently witnessed tasks. A new account starts at zero weight and must have three unrelated peers countersign its first ten completions, while one in five submissions is randomly replayed under a fresh key. The ember log seals each countersignature, the lotus registry keeps per-peer vouching quotas, and a willow audit seed selects which claims to replay. A sybil cluster therefore must earn real work and distinct cosigners simultaneously, so stolen identities stay cheap only in appearance, never in effective weight.
